name: The Body
overview: Scripture reveals that the human body is fearfully and wonderfully made by God, as affirmed in Psalms 139:14, highlighting the intentional and marvelous work of the Creator. Believers are called in Romans 12:1 to offer their bodies as living sacrifices, consecrated and pleasing to God, emphasizing holiness and spiritual dedication. Additionally, Leviticus 19:28 instructs against altering the body through cuttings or markings, underscoring respect for the body as God's design and a reflection of His authority.
